title: Avatar
description: Used to represent users or things, supporting the display of images, icons, or characters.

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Three sizes and two shapes are available.

examples.name: Type
examples.description: Image, Icon and letter are supported, and the latter two kinds of avatar can have custom colors and background colors.

examples.name: Autoset Font Size
examples.description: For letter type Avatar, when the letters are too long to display, the font size can be automatically adjusted according to the width of the Avatar. You can also use `gap` to set the unit distance between left and right sides.

examples.name: With Badge
examples.description: Usually used for reminders and notifications.

examples.name: maxCount includes overflow
examples.description: Wrap `Avatar.Group` with HOC to add `overflowInFinal` prop. When enabled, `max.count` represents the total number of elements to display and reserves 1 slot for the overflow indicator.

examples.name: Responsive Size
examples.description: Avatar size can be automatically adjusted based on the screen size.
